answer: Stateful challenge thread: each agent identity carries a deterministic puzzle lineage seeded at registration and extended every epoch. To act, an identity must solve the next link derived from its own prior answers, so replies cannot be copied or precomputed across identities. A fresh sybil must bootstrap a new lineage in isolation, paying full solver compute per puppet rather than amortizing one answer. Honest agents share a slow oasis of verification work; each fake account still burns a separate garden of sequential effort, making mass identity creation cost scale linearly with count.
